description: This file defines a Kotlin module for managing device authentication tokens within an Android application. It includes data classes for device auth entries, interfaces for token storage, and a concrete implementation that interacts with secure preferences, supporting token loading, saving, and clearing.

classes.name: DeviceAuthEntry
classes.description: Data class representing authentication token details for a device, including token string, role, associated scopes, and last update timestamp.

classes.name: PersistedDeviceAuthMetadata
classes.description: Serializable data class for storing metadata related to device auth tokens, including scopes and timestamp.

classes.name: DeviceAuthTokenStore
classes.description: Interface defining methods for loading, saving, and clearing device authentication tokens.

classes.name: DeviceAuthStore
classes.description: Implementation of DeviceAuthTokenStore that manages token persistence using secure preferences.

methods.name: loadEntry
methods.description: Loads the device authentication entry for given device ID and role from secure storage.

methods.name: saveToken
methods.description: Saves a token and associated scopes for a device ID and role into secure storage.

methods.name: clearToken
methods.description: Removes the stored token and metadata for a given device ID and role.

methods.name: tokenKey
methods.description: Generates the key string used to store the token in preferences.

methods.name: metadataKey
methods.description: Generates the key string used to store token metadata in preferences.

methods.name: normalizeDeviceId
methods.description: Normalizes device ID by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: normalizeRole
methods.description: Normalizes role string by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: normalizeScopes
methods.description: Normalizes list of scope strings by trimming, filtering out empty strings, removing duplicates, and sorting.
